We propose a phased plan that establishes the Ministry’s centralized 24x7 SOC rapidly, then transitions into steady-state Managed Detection & Response for the full three-year term (extendable on performance), with clear service governance and knowledge transfer throughout.

Phase 0 (Mobilization & governance | Weeks 1–2): Contract kick-off, implementation governance, stakeholder mapping across the Ministry data centres and connected federal entities, and confirmation of SLAs and reporting cadence. Delivery will be led by our PMP-certified project managers [CO-PROFILE].

Phase 1 (Assess, design & readiness | Weeks 3–8): Current-state assessment, SOC operating model (L1/L2/L3), logging/onboarding strategy, and target SIEM/SOAR architecture. In parallel we develop incident-response runbooks and forensic-readiness procedures aligned to recognised frameworks, and agree use-cases and playbooks for automation.

Phase 2 (Build & integrate SIEM/SOAR | Months 3–5): Platform build, high-availability design, threat-intelligence integration, and onboarding of priority log sources from data centres and federal entities. Our delivery approach is anchored in multi-month cyber and cloud programmes executed under ISO 27001-certified operations [CO-PROFILE], including federal and provincial government cybersecurity and cloud engagements [CAP-012][CAP-049].

Phase 3 (Pilot SOC & tuning | Months 6–7): 24x7 pilot monitoring, use-case tuning, SOAR playbook validation, and initial threat hunting to baseline normal behaviour.

Phase 4 (Steady-state MDR operations | Months 8–36): Full 24x7 tiered monitoring, continuous threat intelligence, proactive threat hunting, periodic vulnerability assessment, incident response, and monthly/quarterly reporting.

Phase 5 (Knowledge transfer & capacity building | Throughout): Structured knowledge transfer, runbook handover, and joint exercises.

Compliance notes: Our ISO 27001 certification is in place [CO-PROFILE]. Our library does not yet evidence CISSP/GIAC (or equivalent) coverage across all tiers, nor the PKR 1,200M average annual turnover threshold (we evidence PKR 900M) [CO-PROFILE]; we will address the former via certified hiring/partnering and the latter through eligibility clarifications/consortium structuring as permitted.
